DitherButton.icon: An image shown before the label, tinted like the text.
DitherButton.variant: filled is the lit colour surface, outline a faint tint that fills in on hover.
DitherButton.size: sm, md and lg are 32, 36 and 44px high. icon is a 36px square.
DitherButton.bloom: low or high adds a glow in the button's colour.
DitherButton.loading: Steps three cells before the label and ignores clicks.
DitherButton.animated: A dithered sweep on hover and a ripple from where you press.
